findings.issue: The 36-byte init(address) call data is printed by memory words, splitting the selector's padding and the address into 16 + 16 + 4 bytes; in def storage, permissionedVaultActionAllowed and reentranceLocked are merged into one uint16 'stor1_176' (P15) and isLib is not declared, so it prints as 'stor[1].field_160'.
findings.rule: Concatenate Array data by byte ranges: 'Bytes(16, s << 96), Bytes(16, a >> 32), uint32(a) << 224' over 36 bytes is 'Bytes(4, s), address(a)' (zero padding included). Declare one field per distinct access width/offset (here uint8 at offsets 160, 176, 184).

notes: Solc 0.6.12. buyShares, buySharesOnBehalf (900 lines each), buyBackProtocolFeeShares, calcGav, calcGrossShareValue, redeemSharesInKind (1,275) and redeemSharesForSpecificAssets (1,480) were reviewed by structure: the GSN _msgSender (cd[calldata.size - 20] >> 96), the timelock and re-entrance flags, the vault calls (getTrackedAssets, getActiveExternalPositions, burnShares/mintShares, withdrawAssetTo), the fee/policy manager hooks (all to 0x0, artifact), the loops; the small functions were reviewed in full and are correct (e.g. destructActivated's payProtocolFee/deactivateForFund with the failure events and selfdestruct). Source loops: calcGav :495 and :503 (inlined in calcGav, calcGrossShareValue, buyShares, buySharesOnBehalf, buyBackProtocolFeeShares, the redeem functions), redeemSharesInKind :819, AddressArrayLib.contains :80, isUniqueSet :130/:131 (printed as a labelled nested loop 'loop1: while True' with 'continue loop1'), removeItems :154 and :166, __parseRedemptionPayoutAssets :849/:860/:864, __payoutSpecifiedAssetPercentages :885; all shown as while (14 'while True' and 24 'while s < n' instances). The other ~105 whiles are solc 0.6 copies of return data, call arguments and strings (P7, same shapes as c00544). P2: 98 call lines with raw-memory arguments (getManagedAssets / getDebtAssets of external positions, the ValueInterpreter calls, SafeERC20 transfers). P11: 'assert s < len' bounds checks implied by the loop tests. P12: the _assetsToSkip copy duplicated in both arms of the isUniqueSet test (3415-3423).
summary: Faithful and complete with every source loop shown (nested loops nicely labelled); readability suffers from solc 0.6 copy loops, raw-memory call arguments and the zero immutables (artifact).
